result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. While the infrastructure is in good condition, the large roadway width and multiple travel lanes create significant exposure for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to vehicle traffic for an extended period during a single crossing phase.
hazards.location_in_image: The marked crosswalk on the right side of the intersection

hazards.name: Multiple travel lanes
hazards.description: Crossing multiple lanes of traffic increases the risk of multi-threat collisions where one vehicle stops but another in an adjacent lane does not.
hazards.location_in_image: The main roadway crossing the field of view

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and increase the visibility of pedestrians to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages, reducing total exposure time.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and broad, well-maintained sidewalks. While pedestrian infrastructure like bike lanes and street trees are present, the significant crossing distance across multiple travel lanes increases exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the left may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, adjacent to the crosswalk entrance

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: This is a high-density urban environment with a very wide multi-lane roadway that creates significant crossing distances for pedestrians. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk are present, pedestrians are observed crossing mid-block without any physical protection or refuge.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to multiple lanes of traffic for a long duration.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the entire width of the foreground and mid-ground roadway

hazards.name: Unprotected Mid-block Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians are crossing a high-volume, multi-lane road away from the signalized intersection without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image where a group of pedestrians is in the middle of the street

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Signal
interventions.description: Install a HAWK signal or RRFB at the location where pedestrians are naturally crossing mid-block.
